[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended several trails in the Rocky Mountains suitable for the user's bike and riding style, including Monarch Crest Trail, Crested Butte Trails, Buffalo Creek Trail, Grand Teton National Park Trails, Jackson Hole Mountain Resort Trails, Beaverhead-Deerlodge National Forest Trails, Whitefish Trail, Park City Trails, and Snowbird Mountain Resort Trails.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided details about bike-friendly accommodations in Estes Park, including The Estes Park Resort, The Historic Stanley Hotel, Estes Park Condos, and Yosemite Creek Lodge.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned transportation options in Estes Park, including a free shuttle service, Estes Park Bike Shop, and private bike shuttle services.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested bringing a bike lock, basic toolkit, and plenty of water, snacks, and sun protection for the trip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant discussed the pros and cons of using a hitch-mounted bike rack versus a bike shipping service for transporting the user's bike.  
[FACT] User decided to go with a hitch-mounted bike rack for transporting their bike.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for using a hitch-mounted bike rack, including checking compatibility, securing the bike, packing a bike tool kit, planning the route and accommodations, and checking weather and trail conditions.
